services.name: trial lesson
services.desc: Community School of Music and Arts has been the leader in high-quality music education in Silicon Valley since our founding in 1968 and we are thrilled to bring music learning to the Belmont area! The CSMA program stands out because of our highly qualified music faculty-they have trained in many of the top music schools in the world and work collaboratively with students to achieve their goals. Our Belmont music program features personalized instruction in piano, guitar, violin and voice. We offer private lessons for children, teens and adults. Enrollment is now open, and we invite you to sign up for a trial lesson for only $30 - with no commitment! Complete our Private Lesson Placement

services.desc: The Mohr Gallery showcases a diverse artwork from seasoned professionals, emerging artists and student groups. See you in 2027 for our annual celebration of the arts in support of CSMA’s mission. CSMA’s Gala is the annual school celebration and fundraising event. In 2026, supporters enjoyed a magical evening of live music, art, wine, and fine dining at the picturesque Palo Alto Hills Golf & Country Club. Proceeds from the Gala provided school subsidies and financial aid for students who would otherwise have no access to the arts.
